title: Chocolate-Dipped Strawberries
short: Glossy dark chocolate, crunchy toppings, ready in 20 minutes.
keywords: Chocolate-Dipped Strawberries, date night, dinner for two, playful, classic
intro: Chocolate strawberries are a romantic cliché for a reason: they are beautiful, easy and everybody loves them. The keys are bone-dry berries, chocolate melted gently, and toppings added while the chocolate is still wet.
why: They look like they came from a chocolatier, and they double as a sweet gift if you are invited to someone else's dinner.

ings.i: large strawberries with green tops, washed and completely dry

ings.h: 115 g (4 oz)
30 g (1 oz)

ings.i: toppings: crushed pistachios, flaky salt, freeze-dried raspberry

steps.t: Line a tray with parchment. Make sure the berries are completely dry and at room temperature; any water will make the chocolate seize.
Melt the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over barely simmering water, or in the microwave in 20-second bursts. Stop when about two thirds has melted and stir until smooth. Stir in the coconut oil.
Hold each berry by its leaves, dip three quarters of the way, twist and let the excess drip back. Lay it on the parchment and add toppings right away.
Melt the white chocolate and drizzle it over with a fork.
Let set for 15 minutes in the fridge or 30 at room temperature. Serve the same day.

tips: Don't refrigerate them overnight; condensation makes the chocolate sweat.
Stirring to finish melting keeps the chocolate glossy and snappy.
makeahead: Best within 6 hours of dipping. Keep at cool room temperature.
plating: Arrange on a small board or a slate with a few unshelled pistachios.
wine: Brut rosé Champagne or Moscato d'Asti.

faq.q: My chocolate went thick and grainy.
faq.a: It seized from water or overheating. Stir in a teaspoon of warm cream to rescue it for drizzling.
